// diagnostic

E0620

Imported script `{file}` has executable top-level statements

What

Imported script `{file}` has executable top-level statements

Why

Only the entry file owns the implicit `run`; importing a script would execute a dependency as a hidden side effect.

Fix

Move the statements into the entry file's `fn run`, or import a declaration-only file.
